composition_subtypes.role: Build maximum MEX sequentially by filling missing numbers
Eliminate distinct numbers with smallest frequency first to reduce DIFF

payload.core_composition_summary: Two-phase greedy: MEX built by filling smallest missing numbers, then DIFF reduced by eliminating cheapest distinct numbers via min-heap.
payload.rationale: The MEX phase greedily fills gaps from 0 upward, using exchange argument. After MEX is set, distinct numbers >= MEX are eliminated by always taking the smallest frequency group from a heap, using remaining operations optimally.
